notes.title: News & Statistics from the Unfinished Game Company
notes.content:
[p]The Unfinished Game™ management team is proud to announce that we've reach over [b]300 copies sold[/b] across the globe. It might not be much, but it's quite the honest work for a first game! 


[b]Statistics and interesting facts about the game :[/b][/p][list][*][p]All players so far managed to finish the tutorial (it would have been quite shameful otherwise).[/p][/*][*][p]Over 1000 players tested the Demo version of the game![/p][/*][*][p]Over 60 testers were able to complete all the achievements![/p][/*][*][p]Over 180 testers were able to reach the ending and release the Unfinished Game™![/p][/*][*][p]The hardest level achievement is the speedrun of the Race level.[/p][/*][*][p]Several speedrunners were able to finish the all levels with a combined time under 10 minutes! (time to refund the game hehe!)[/p][/*][*][p]So far... all Steam reviews are positive![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot to every testers, speerunners and players that enjoyed the game so far! As always, if you have any feedback or issues, don't hesitate to hit the Discord or Steam Discussions and I'll try to help! 


May the journey continue! - Vinzzi [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060382/76830cc06d01c235329a93b80909f1d0dd5007ef.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug fix for version 9.2 :[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue when after a crash, Steam would try to launch back the demo version of the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 9.0
notes.content:
[p]The Unfinished Game Management Team™ decided to help the speedrunners out there with some backend autosplitter support!

Have fun finishing the game as fast as possible ;)[/p]

notes.title: Update 8.9
notes.content:
[p]Welcome testers! It seems the Unfinished Game is still unfinished after all! With your help we fixed a couple of issues and added some little quality of life!
[/p][list][*][p]Tweaked some radio volume across different levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed nature sounds and radio in Graphic level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Buggy Affair" achievement wouldn't unlock when taking the last bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio issues with certain sounds not scaling with volume (ex: jump pad).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed grappling issue when starting the race in the Race Drop level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occlusion render issue with doors in the Final level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Water Level title typo.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a NPC and some small details in the Final level.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a screen recap with all the levels time in the lobby (at the place of the total time one).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: An Unfinished Game is now available!
notes.content:
[p][b]The Unfinished Games Testing facility is proud to announce the release of our unfinished game!
[/b][/p][p]It took us a long time and the lives of many testers, but we have finally achieved our ultimate goal: releasing an (un)finished game. The upper management is proud of all your efforts!
[/p][p][b]Thank you to everyone who participated in this adventure. See you soon in the factory!

-Vinzzi[/b][/p]
